_doc: Hand-entered values for gaps that peer-median imputation gets badly wrong. Each entry: value, source, confidence (high|medium|low). Applied after WB/WPP/IMF and before imputation.

hiv.source: UNAIDS estimate (~1.3M people living with HIV)
Russian Federal AIDS Centre: ~1.2 million people living with HIV (~0.8% of the whole population, higher at 15-49); UNAIDS publishes no estimate
CDC: ~1.2 million people living with HIV (~0.36% of the population, slightly higher at 15-49)
